rows.grounds: fused sandhi compound with members siddhi, saṃprāpti, mūla, kaula

items.question: What is identified as root Kaula together with the eight siddhis?
items.inference: The verse identifies siddhi attainment as root Kaula alongside eight siddhis.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic relation of aṣṭau to siddhi attainment remains unclear.
items.plain_english: Eight, and siddhi-attainment is root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
